description: Na₄Th(WO₄)₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/a space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with six equivalent WO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.54 Å. Th is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.42 Å) and four longer (2.43 Å) Th-O bond lengths. W is bonded to four O atoms to form WO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-1.87 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Th, and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Th, and one W atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one W atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one W atom.
